apps.localizedDescription: Community-maintained enhanced build of Nuvio Mobile for iOS and iPadOS, with experimental features, quality-of-life improvements, playback refinements, and UI enhancements.

versions.localizedDescription: Nuvio Enhanced 0.3.1 Build 102. Adds favorite actors and expanded actor pages, actor search, redesigned downloads, subtitle font customization, estimated finish-time overlay, background stream prefetch, and improved iOS 4K playback. Also includes player, brightness, Hero, Continue Watching, download UI, and stability fixes.

Nuvio Enhanced 0.2.23 Build 98. Adds cleaner long-press poster and episode actions, synopsis previews, improved Home hero behavior, Live TV playback compatibility, update detection, crash reporting, and UI/stability fixes.

Nuvio Enhanced 0.2.23 Build 97. Adds Arabic and Russian support, animated gradient themes, improved stream-source hiding, Hero rating controls, Trakt redirect fixes, AI assistant restoration, and multiple playback/UI fixes.

Nuvio Enhanced 0.2.21 Build 95. Introduces the Streaming Showcase Hero, improved Home state and scrolling, stronger Trakt/Continue Watching sync, iOS player rotation and AudioUnit stability improvements, performance optimizations, and localization updates.

Nuvio Enhanced 0.2.19 Build 94. First Enhanced release line using bundle ID com.nuvio.enhanced, allowing side-by-side installation with the original Nuvio. Adds plugin filters, Hero artwork controls, optional content warnings, DNS UI improvements, GIF profile search, and iOS GIF avatar improvements.
